canonical_title: Ground load; asymmetrical loads on multiple-wheel units

versions.title_at_revision: Ground load; unsymmetrical loads on multiple-wheel units
versions.text:
(a) Pivoting loads. The UAV is assumed to pivot about one side of the main gear with (1) The brakes on the pivoting unit locked; and (2) Loads corresponding to a limit vertical load factor of 1 and coefficient of friction of 0.8, applied to the main gear and its supporting structure.
(b) Unequal tyre loads. The loads established under USAR.471 to USAR.483 must be applied in turn, in a 60/40% distribution, to the dual wheels and tyres in each dual wheel landing gear unit.
(c) Deflated tyre loads. For the deflated tyre condition (1) 60% of the loads established under USAR.471 to USAR.483 must be applied in turn to each wheel in a landing gear unit; and (2) 60% of the limit drag and sideloads and 100% of the limit vertical load established under USAR.485 and USAR.493 or lesser vertical load obtained under sub-paragraph (1), must be applied in turn to each wheel in the dual wheel landing gear unit.

versions.title_at_revision: Ground load; asymmetrical loads on multiple-wheel units
versions.text:
(a) Pivoting loads. The UA is assumed to pivot about one side of the main gear with:
  (1) The brakes on the pivoting unit locked; and
  (2) Loads corresponding to a limit vertical load factor of 1 and coefficient of friction of 0.8, applied to the main gear and its supporting structure.
(b) Unequal tyre loads. The loads established under USAR.471 to USAR.483 must be applied in turn, in a 60/40% distribution, to the dual wheels and tyres in each dual wheel landing gear unit.
(c) Deflated tyre loads. For the deflated tyre condition:
  (1) 60% of the loads established under USAR.471 to USAR.483 must be applied in turn to each wheel in a landing gear unit; and
  (2) 60% of the limit drag and sideloads and 100% of the limit vertical load established under USAR.485 and USAR.493 or lesser vertical load obtained under sub-paragraph (1), must be applied in turn to each wheel in the dual wheel landing gear unit.
